title: Your passkeys
body: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password.

empty.title: No passkeys yet
empty.body: Add one below, and your next sign-in needs no password.

add.title: Add a passkey
add.body: For this device. You can add one on each device you use.
add.nameHint: Leave it empty to name it after this browser. You can rename it later.
add.addedBody: You can use it the next time you sign in.

off.title: Your organisation has turned off passkeys
off.body: You can't add one while they're off. Ask your administrator if you need one.

unsupported.title: This browser can't make passkeys
unsupported.body: Use an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox, or add one on another device.

loadError.title: Your passkeys didn't load
loadError.body: Check your connection, then try again.

signedOut.title: Sign in to see your passkeys
signedOut.body: You need to be signed in to see or add passkeys.

errors.generic: We couldn't add your passkey. Please try again.
errors.cancelled: The passkey wasn't created. You can try again.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This device already has a passkey for your account.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.disabled: Your organization has turned off passkeys.
errors.expired: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.invalidName: Use a name of 1 to 64 characters.
errors.refused: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
errors.load: We couldn't load your passkeys. Please try again.
